import json
import cache
import service

# Test cache key uniqueness and correctness

def test_cache_key_uniqueness():
    assert cache.key(1, "job1", 1) != cache.key(1, "job1", 2)
    assert cache.key(1, "job1", 1) != cache.key(2, "job1", 1)
    assert cache.key(1, "job1", 1) != cache.key(1, "job2", 1)

# Test cache hit/miss behavior

def test_cache_hit_miss():
    store = {}
    compute_calls = []
    
    def mock_compute():
        compute_calls.append(True)
        return 42
    
    # First call should trigger compute
    result1 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job1", 1, mock_compute)
    assert result1 == 42
    assert len(compute_calls) == 1
    
    # Second call with same key should hit cache
    result2 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job1", 1, mock_compute)
    assert result2 == 42
    assert len(compute_calls) == 1  # No additional compute call
    
    # Different profile version should trigger compute again
    result3 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job1", 2, mock_compute)
    assert result3 == 42
    assert len(compute_calls) == 2

# Test cache respects all three identifiers

def test_cache_respects_all_identifiers():
    store = {}
    compute_calls = []
    
    def mock_compute(user_id, job_id, profile_version):
        compute_calls.append((user_id, job_id, profile_version))
        return f"score_{user_id}_{job_id}_{profile_version}"
    
    # First call
    result1 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job1", 1, lambda: mock_compute(1, "job1", 1))
    assert result1 == "score_1_job1_1"
    assert len(compute_calls) == 1
    
    # Second call with same user_id, job_id, profile_version
    result2 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job1", 1, lambda: mock_compute(1, "job1", 1))
    assert result2 == "score_1_job1_1"
    assert len(compute_calls) == 1
    
    # Third call with different user_id
    result3 = service.get_score(store, 2, "job1", 1, lambda: mock_compute(2, "job1", 1))
    assert result3 == "score_2_job1_1"
    assert len(compute_calls) == 2
    
    # Fourth call with different job_id
    result4 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job2", 1, lambda: mock_compute(1, "job2", 1))
    assert result4 == "score_1_job2_1"
    assert len(compute_calls) == 3
    
    # Fifth call with different profile_version
    result5 = service.get_score(store, 1, "job1", 2, lambda: mock_compute(1, "job1", 2))
    assert result5 == "score_1_job1_2"
    assert len(compute_calls) == 4

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_cache_key_uniqueness()
    test_cache_hit_miss()
    test_cache_respects_all_identifiers()
    print("All tests passed!")
